name: Alert
summary: An alert is a short message with a tone: info, success, warning or error. Use it to report the result of something the person did, or a condition they need to know about. The icon is decoration and the word carries the tone, and the live role belongs on the container the message lands in, never on the message.
demoNote: Everything under Common mistakes is live. Press the three buttons in example 3: they look identical and leave identical DOM behind, and only one of them was announced.

contract.useWhen: An inline message: the word carries the tone, the icon carries nothing.
keyboard: native: to and from the dismiss button, and to any link in the text
native: dismisses. The handler owes focus somewhere afterwards
